definitions.gloss: to whip, to beat, to whisk
definitions.explanation: To vigorously stir a liquid (such as cream or eggs) to incorporate air and create foam or increase volume. A key cooking technique.
To create foam or lather from soap, shampoo, or similar products.

examples.japanese: {生|なま}クリームを{泡立|あわだ}てる。
{卵白|らんぱく}を{泡立|あわだ}ててメレンゲを{作|つく}る。
examples.english: To beat egg whites to make meringue.

examples.japanese: {泡立|あわだ}て{器|き}で{卵|たまご}を{泡立|あわだ}てる。
examples.english: To beat eggs with a whisk.

examples.japanese: シャンプーを{手|て}で{泡立|あわだ}てる。
examples.english: To lather shampoo with your hands.

notes:
COMPOSITION: {泡|あわ} (bubble, foam) + {立|た}てる (to make stand/rise). Literally "to make foam rise."

TRANSITIVITY PAIR:
・{泡立|あわだ}てる ({他動詞|たどうし}): to whip (someone whips something)
・{泡立|あわだ}つ ({自動詞|じどうし}): to foam up (something foams by itself)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{生|なま}クリームを{泡立|あわだ}てる (to whip cream)
・{卵白|らんぱく}を{泡立|あわだ}てる (to beat egg whites)
・{卵|たまご}を{泡立|あわだ}てる (to beat eggs)
・しっかり{泡立|あわだ}てる (to whip thoroughly)
・{軽|かる}く{泡立|あわだ}てる (to whip lightly)

COOKING TOOLS:
・{泡立|あわだ}て{器|き} (whisk)
・ハンドミキサー (hand mixer)
・{電動|でんどう}{泡立|あわだ}て{器|き} (electric whisk)

COOKING TIPS:
・{七|しち}{分|ぶ}{立|だ}て (whipped to soft peaks)
・{八|はち}{分|ぶ}{立|だ}て (whipped to firm peaks)
・{角|つの}が{立|た}つまで (until peaks form)
